jobs.description:
**Overview**

Deputy Director of Information Technology

**Boone County, Missouri**

Boone County is seeking an experienced technology leader to serve as **Deputy Director of Information Technology**. This is a senior leadership position responsible for supporting the Director in the strategic direction, administration, and day-to-day operations of the County’s technology services.

As second in command of the department, the Deputy Director plays a key role in shaping the County’s technology strategy, leading managers and major initiatives, overseeing critical support functions, and ensuring reliable, secure, and effective technology services across County government. This position serves as Director in their absence.

What You’ll Do

In this role, you will:

* Supervise managers responsible for **Information Technology, GIS, Mail Services, and Facilities Security**.
* Lead and support departmental operations, staffing, payroll, budgeting, personnel administration, contracts, and major technology projects.
* Partner closely with the Director on **strategic planning, technology priorities, vendor relations, contract negotiations, and organizational initiatives**.
* Work with County leadership to identify technology needs, establish priorities, evaluate system capacity, and plan future equipment and technology investments.
* Help establish and maintain standards for computer hardware, software, systems, and technology services.
* Oversee the County’s GIS operations, including GIS data quality, web services, programming, and related centralized services.
* Provide leadership for Mail Services operations serving County facilities.
* Oversee Facilities Security technology, including electronic access control, alarms, and video security systems.
* Manage complex projects and help ensure departmental goals and service expectations are met.
* Build strong working relationships with County departments, vendors, employees, and members of the public.

What We’re Looking For

The successful candidate will bring strong leadership skills along with broad knowledge of modern information technology operations. We are looking for someone who can balance strategic thinking with the practical demands of managing people, projects, budgets, and critical technology services.

Strong candidates will have experience with areas such as:

* IT leadership and project management
* Application development and enterprise systems
* Networks, servers, telecommunications, and desktop technologies
* Relational databases and cloud-based solutions
* Website and content management technologies
* GIS principles and systems
* Information security and technology compliance
* Budgeting, contracts, procurement, and vendor management
* Hiring, developing, supervising, and evaluating staff
* Large-scale organizational or technology initiatives

The position requires strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to establish productive working relationships across departments and with the public.

Minimum Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in **Computer Science, Business, Administration, or a closely related field**
* Five years of information technology services experience
* Personnel management experience, preferably in a government environment

Preferred Qualifications

* Advanced degree in **Business or Public Administration**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a closely related field
* Five years of personnel management experience, preferably in government

Additional Requirements

This position works primarily in a professional office environment and requires the ability to travel between County locations. A valid ability to operate a vehicle in accordance with County vehicle policies is required.

Why Boone County?

This is an opportunity to take on a highly visible leadership role supporting technology and essential services throughout Boone County government. The Deputy Director will have the opportunity to influence long-term technology strategy while working closely with County leadership and an experienced team of technology professionals.

**Benefit-eligible employees receive** paid vacation, 14 paid holidays, enrollment in the County Employees Retirement Fund, two matching deferred compensation plans, low- or no-cost employee health insurance options, County-paid employee dental coverage, subsidized dependent premiums, and County-paid life and long-term disability insurance.

Apply

Apply by clicking the **Apply Now** link or visiting www.boonemo.gov/hr. You will be directed to Boone County’s online application system, where you can create or log in to your applicant profile.

Questions? Call **(573) 886-4395**. Please contact us in advance if you need an accommodation to complete the application process.

Pay: $97,094.00 - $100,027.00 per year

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible schedule
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Do you have a bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field

Experience:

* personnel management: 5 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

The IT Director will also drive strategic initiatives, including infrastructure modernization, cybersecurity, and service excellence in a complex healthcare environment.

The East Hawaii Region recently transitioned to Epic as the organization’s electronic health record (EHR) system. This position works in collaboration with the EHR Director who owns Epic application strategy, build, optimization, training, and application support. The IT Director owns the technical platform and operational services that Epic depends on in addition to the technology services required for the facilities.

Prior leadership experience should be at the Director or Executive level, or equivalent.

* Strong proficiency in network and wireless operations

**About Vantage**
=================

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

**Cybersecurity Department**
----------------------------

The Information Security function safeguards Vantage’s global digital infrastructure, customer trust, and operational resilience as the company scales across 19+ markets. The team partners closely with Technology, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Data Center Operations, and business leadership to ensure security is embedded into every stage of the customer, construction, and operations lifecycle — protecting the critical infrastructure that powers the world’s hyperscale and enterprise cloud customers.

**Position Overview**
---------------------

The Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) provides strategic leadership for the organization’s information security program. This role is responsible for defining and executing the enterprise-wide security strategy, protecting critical assets, ensuring regulatory compliance, and managing cyber risk across all business operations. The CISO collaborates with executive leadership, IT, risk, compliance, and business units globally to align security initiatives with organizational objectives while fostering a culture of security awareness and operational excellence. The CISO champions innovation in security technologies and maintains a proactive posture against emerging cyber threats, ensuring the company’s resilience and reputation.

You will build a capability, not run a report. The benchmark you create will sit behind pricing, product decisions, and executive reporting across a growing global portfolio — and you will decide what it covers, how it is governed, and when it is strong enough to stand behind. Few roles offer this combination of commercial substance, methodological ownership, and visibility at one of the industry’s fastest-scaling companies.

As Vantage's CISO, you will own enterprise security as a board-level, business-critical mandate — not a back-office IT function. You will be the executive voice translating cyber risk into business risk for the CEO and Board, carrying direct accountability for regulatory disclosure and personal liability exposure under frameworks like the SEC Cybersecurity Disclosure Rule. Your remit spans the full convergence of Vantage's environment: traditional IT alongside the operational technology, building management, and physical control systems that run our data centers, plus the cloud-native and multi-tenant security architecture that underpins compliance attestations and due diligence for hyperscale customers.

You will own security posture through the lens of growth — leading due diligence and integration for greenfield markets and acquisitions across 19+ markets — while positioning security as a driver of innovation and competitive differentiation through AI-enabled threat foresight rather than purely reactive defense. Finally, you will own security as a commercial enabler, partnering with Sales and Legal so that Vantage's security posture becomes a trust differentiator that helps win and retain the world's largest hyperscale and enterprise cloud customers.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Develop and execute the enterprise information security strategy, ensuring alignment with business objectives and regulatory requirements.

* Oversee the design, implementation, and monitoring of security programs, policies, procedures, and controls to safeguard corporate assets, data, and infrastructure.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate cyber risks, vulnerabilities, and threats, maintaining enterprise-wide risk visibility and reporting to the executive team and board.
* Partner with IT, legal, compliance, risk management, and business units to ensure security considerations are embedded in all operational and strategic initiatives.
* Lead incident response planning and execution, including threat detection, containment, investigation, and post-incident analysis.
* Evaluate emerging security technologies, trends, and regulatory changes, recommending adoption or adjustments to the security strategy.
* Drive security awareness and training programs across the organization to strengthen the security culture.
* Establish metrics, reporting, and continuous improvement processes to measure the effectiveness of security programs.
* Represent the organization externally to regulators, auditors, partners, and industry groups on security matters.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and adherence to company values.
* Perform additional duties as assigned by management.

**Job Requirements**
--------------------

* Advanced degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or related field; relevant experience may substitute for education.
* 15+ years of progressive experience in information security, IT risk management, or related fields, with at least 5–7 years in a senior leadership role.
* Demonstrated experience developing and executing enterprise-wide security strategies, including regulatory compliance (e.g., GDPR, ISO 27001, NIST, SOC 2).
* Expertise in security technologies, threat intelligence, risk management, cloud security, network security, application security, and incident response.
* Proven ability to lead, mentor, and develop high-performing global security teams.
* Strong collaboration, communication, and executive stakeholder management skills in complex or matrixed org

Compass International Holdings is seeking a Lead, Inventory Product, Data & Ops to make sure our inventory products work as promised across all ten brands, and to rebuild how that work gets done with AI.

You will report to the Director, Inventory Product, Data & Ops. This team owns the technical and operational backbone of listing distribution: when a listing moves from an agent to the MLS, our agent platform, our brand websites, and portals, we make sure it happens correctly, on time, and per the seller's instructions. This is a hybrid seat. You understand the business well enough to know what matters to an agent and a seller, and the technology well enough to sit with Product and Engineering, read a spec, and see where it will break. You are AI-first by default. Not someone who only uses AI to move faster on their own work, but someone who builds, stress tests, and deploys AI systems.

Every inventory program Compass International Holdings runs depends on the product doing what we told agents and clients it would do. This role is how we know it does. It is also how a small team operates at national scale: by letting AI run the work that used to take people, and freeing leadership to focus on where the product and the MLS landscape go next.

**At Compass You Will**
-----------------------

### **Inventory Product Testing & Validation**

* Own day-to-day execution of QA testing and quality validation (including secret shopping) for inventory products across the MLS, agent platform, brand websites, and portals
* Build and maintain standard testing practices: test plans, scenario libraries, pass/fail criteria, defect severity levels, and readout templates, so every test runs the same way no matter who runs it
* Coordinate offshore testing teams: scope the work, write clear test instructions, set turnaround expectations, and review output against a quality bar
* Partner with Product and Engineering as new features approach release; read requirements, map the scenarios and edge cases that need coverage (by brand, market, MLS rule set, listing status, and seller instruction), and get tests designed before launch rather than after
* Organize test readouts: synthesize results, prioritize defects by business impact, and bring a clear recommendation to the Director, Product, and brand stakeholders
* Track defects to resolution and confirm fixes in production through regression testing
* Apply AI to testing itself, from generating scenario coverage off a requirements doc to automating repeatable checks and secret shopping
* Support technical readiness for new launches by validating that products work as expected before they reach agents

### **Documentation, Tracking & Organization**

* Be the team's system of record: keep test plans, results, defects, automations, SOPs, and decisions documented, current, and easy to find
* Build and maintain the trackers the team runs on (testing cycles, automation builds, open issues, requests, and cross-functional commitments) so status is always visible without anyone having to ask
* Organize every cross-functional interaction with Product, Engineering, Data & Analytics, offshore teams, and brand stakeholders: notes, decisions, action items, owners, and due dates, with follow-through until each item is closed
* Document every automation so others can understand, audit, maintain, and improve it
* Keep a clean record of product behavior, known issues, and MLS rule interpretations so answers never live in one person's head
* Set documentation and tracking standards for the team, so the Director and partners can get full context fast

### **AI Automation & Process Rebuild**

* Help build, test, and deploy AI automations for the processes the Director and team have prioritized, so AI owns the work end to end and people review exceptions
